description: Test A null calibration with a LUMINOUS-companion alternative (Section 6 experiment with two luminous sources): q_f and q_M free in the BSPL (fit_policy_test_a_luminous_v1.json). The null light curves are PSPL, so this run uses the SAME H0 events as the dark-companion calibration: pi_E = 0 PSPL truths at tE = 30 d, F146 = 21, g = 0, u0 nodes 0, 1, 4, 5, 6 of the H0 catalog (0.005, 0.0136, 0.271, 0.737, 2.0; they bracket u0 = 0.01, 0.3, 1 of the two-luminous maps), 50 realizations each (the first 50, as gv_sec6_h0_v1 and gv_sec6_h0_u6_v1). The runner JSON/NPZ of those runs are linked into json/ (the PSPL fit does not depend on the alternative model); only lrt_omega_profile.py is run, with the luminous policy, then lrt_gross_vitells.py --group-by-config --extra-alphas 0.00135 0.0027.
